title: From question to action
text: Every scooter has a story. But when something goes wrong, finding the right information can feel like starting from scratch. Italian Rides connects the machine in front of you to the knowledge and people that can help.

title: Understand the machine
text: Start by exploring a prepared three-dimensional study of the front assembly. You can look around the controls, separate the major elements and see where the mirror belongs. This is an illustrative reference, built to help an owner understand the machine.

title: Start with your concern
text: Now imagine noticing a cracked mirror. The owner selects a photo and describes the problem in their own words. For this demonstration, we are using a clearly labelled simulated image and a GTS 125 reference.

title: The agent investigates
text: The agent reviews the photo and the owner's concern, chooses a relevant component, and asks Meta's Segment Anything model to outline it. Then it sends a real crop for a closer look. The visual selection and the model's observations stay visible as the process unfolds.

title: Review the finding
text: The owner remains in control. They review the suggestion, confirm the component, and can inspect practical guidance with the manual references that support it. The image can guide attention, but it is not proof of fitment or a diagnosis.

title: A useful next step
text: The inspection becomes an editable request for a workshop. It brings together the scooter details, the selected component, and the owner's concern, while marking the model's observation as unverified. The owner can review the wording before sharing it.

title: The story stays with the scooter
text: With one more action, the owner records the decision in their garage. Here, the mirror is planned work, not a completed repair. The scooter's history now connects that concern to the next step, and remains available in this browser.

title: Another part, same journey
text: The same pattern works for another component. A front tyre can be outlined and explored, with guidance on checking pressure and wear. A photo cannot measure tyre pressure or establish roadworthiness. Those checks happen in person.

title: Italian Rides
text: Italian Rides turns curiosity into understanding, and understanding into a useful action. From the machine you see, to the knowledge that keeps it moving.
